$description: Tooltip (platform/components/Tooltip), library wave 5, lane C: the tokens of the start placement and of the rich tooltip. The rich surface is the popover's: the overlay surface, the default border, the menu radius and the menu shadow; nothing here adds a color.

tooltip-bubble-start-inset-inline-end.$description: Tooltip placement start (drawn inside the wrapper, where anchor positioning is missing): the gap to the trigger, as the other sides.

tooltip-bubble-start-arrow-color.$description: Tooltip placement start: the arrow on the end edge, in the bubble's fill.

tooltip-rich-background.$description: Rich tooltip: the surface (the overlay surface, as Popover).

tooltip-rich-text.$description: Rich tooltip: the body's text color.

tooltip-rich-radius.$description: Rich tooltip: the corners (the menu radius, as Popover).

tooltip-rich-shadow.$description: Rich tooltip: the shadow (the menu elevation, as Popover).

tooltip-rich-padding.$description: Rich tooltip: the padding inside the border, on every side.

tooltip-rich-max-width.$description: Rich tooltip: it wraps at 320px (the popover's md width).

tooltip-rich-font-size.$description: Rich tooltip: the size of the title and the body.

tooltip-rich-line-height.$description: Rich tooltip: the line height of a few sentences.

tooltip-rich-gap.$description: Rich tooltip: the space between the title and the body.

tooltip-rich-title-font-family.$description: Rich tooltip: the title's face (as Popover).

tooltip-rich-action-margin-block-start.$description: Rich tooltip: the extra space above the action (with the gap, one sm step).

tooltip-rich-close-delay.$description: Rich tooltip: how long it stays after the pointer leaves the trigger and the tooltip, so the pointer can move into it (as the hover card).
